title: WHEELS & TIRES-CONTENTS
summary: Wheels & tires group contents (A1 contents, A2 spare tire storage) plus the road wheel and tire assembly: tire mounted on the wheel with soap lubricant, balanced with clip-on wheel weights, wheel held to the hub by lug nuts (60-80 lb ft). The trim ring (beauty ring) and hub cap (center cap) and the instruction sheet ship loose with the car.

parts.name: RING UNIT
parts.name_expanded: Ring unit – wheel trim ring (beauty ring)

materials.where: tire beads at the wheel rim

fastening.note: Lug nuts [4] on the hub studs through the wheel [3] center.
Tire [1] mounted on the wheel with 10a soap lubricant on the beads (not an adhesive; a mounting lubricant). Valve assembly comes with the tire unit and goes in the wheel (note C).
Balance weights per chart [2] on the rim edge (note B).
Trim ring [5] and hub cap [6] shown exploded off the wheel; they ship loose (note D, UPC 0-C1). No retainers shown.

notes: NOTE: Maximum temperature of tires to be 180°F during reshaping process at assembly plants regardless of the length of time in oven.

NOTE (rev 3): All tires of the same size and ply rating on a vehicle must be the same make and in the same outside-diameter group (group number, about 2.00" high, written in yellow wax crayon on the back sidewall; groups 1-6).
NOTE: Match the marks on the tire and the wheel so that they are on a radial line or within one inch of each other.
B: Check every wheel & tire asm for static unbalance; if more than 5 oz of weight is needed, reject the assembly.
C: Install valve assembly tubeless tire (part of tire unit as received) in wheel assembly.
D: See Misc. Shipping List - UPC 0 - C1.
